scope: XZ reduction, not a reproduction of the paper's full 3D solver or measured table
inertia: 2*m*R^2/5; calculated uniform-sphere inertia, paper rounds to 0.000055 kg m^2
normalModelSections: hertz/material, damping coeff_restitution, limit_damping; unilateral-force correction scale fitted on an isolated 4m/s pair only
normalModel: Hertz K*delta^1.5 plus restitution damping; differs from the paper's Lankarani-Nikravesh damping
tangentialModel: Dissipative Coulomb force smoothly limited below 0.01m/s; planar side-spin and midpoint torque arms

fourBall.timeOrigin: paper initial positions projected to plane; first free-flight contact occurs analytically before numerical reference interval
omitted: cloth friction and cushions during the short free-space impact interval
fourBall.comparison: independent SciPy DOP853 integration of documented reduced equations; not the authors' published output curve

rollingCut.assumptions: equal masses, elastic frictionless ball collision, initially rolling cue; direction measured when rolling resumes

clothReference.status: published software reference parameters, not measurements of this project table
